about: Agroshield is a pre-blended argon and carbon dioxide mixture. Argon–CO₂ blends are widely used as shielding gas for MIG/MAG welding, where the argon gives a stable arc and the CO₂ improves penetration on carbon and low-alloy steels.
Buying the mixture pre-blended avoids on-site mixing errors and keeps the composition consistent. Tell us your welding process and material so we can confirm it suits your job.
